key_information_units.information: Consolidated net sales decreased 3.4% to €7.33 million in 2025 from €7.59 million in 2024, with EU sales (92% of total) remaining flat and sales to Africa/Asia dropping sharply; real estate management revenue fell to €3 thousand from €25 thousand.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report Overview section (pages 4-5), Note 15 Revenue breakdown (page 50)

key_information_units.information: Consolidated EBITDA was -€0.42 million in 2025 (vs -€0.03 million in 2024) with a margin of -6% (vs 0%), and net loss widened to €1.15 million from €0.79 million; the decline was driven by underutilized production capacity increasing costs and a planned December 2025 factory shutdown for new gas boiler house transition (compared to an unplanned weather-related shutdown in 2024).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report Overview of Operating Results (page 4), EBITDA by Business Segments table (page 4), Management Report Fibreboard Production section (page 4-5)

key_information_units.information: Total assets increased to €9.3 million (from €8.3 million in 2024), with current assets at €1.829 million (including inventories of €1.034 million and cash of €5 thousand) and total liabilities at €4.9 million; equity rose to €4.462 million.

Operating activities generated net cash outflow of €503 thousand (vs €174 thousand outflow in 2024); investing activities used €989 thousand (primarily €1.367 million in production assets and €161 thousand in real estate, partially offset by €539 thousand proceeds from sale of TPD shares); financing activities provided €1.444 million net cash inflow, primarily from a €2.0 million share capital increase completed in October 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows (page 25), Note 13 Equity movements (page 49)

key_information_units.information: Fibreboard production and sales accounted for 100% of revenue (€7.33 million) with EBITDA of -€296 thousand; real estate management contributed minimal revenue (€3 thousand) and EBITDA of -€86 thousand, reflecting terminated rental agreements.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 22 Operating Segments (page 52), Real Estate Management section (page 5)

key_information_units.information: The group merged with subsidiary Pärnu Riverside Development OÜ effective June 1, 2025; the Admirali Quarter development project achieved completed design works and building permits for key areas.

After the reporting period, a preliminary sale-purchase agreement was signed on January 8, 2026, for ten Admirali Quarter properties, with finalization conditional on satisfaction of terms by June 30, 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 26 Events after balance sheet date (page 55)
